<?php
namespace {
    const ComposedFirst = static function () { return 'g1'; };
    const ComposedSecond = static function () { return 'g2'; };
    trait ComposedRetryLeft { public static function target() { return 'left'; } }
    trait ComposedRetryRight { public static function target() { return 'right'; } }
}
namespace ComposedRetry {
    function take($a = [ComposedFirst, \ComposedRetryLeft::target(...), ComposedFirst,
                       ComposedSecond, \ComposedRetryRight::target(...), ComposedSecond]) { return $a; }
    function stream() {
        try { take(); } catch (\Exception $e) { echo 'X|'; }
        $a = take();
        yield $a;
        return 'done';
    }
    $seen = 0;
    set_error_handler(static function ($level, $message) use (&$seen) {
        ++$seen;
        echo 'H', $seen, '|';
        if ($seen === 1) {
            eval('namespace ComposedRetry; const ComposedFirst = static function () { return "l1"; };');
        } elseif ($seen === 2) {
            eval('namespace ComposedRetry; const ComposedSecond = static function () { return "l2"; };');
            throw new \Exception('stop');
        }
        return true;
    });
    $fiber = new \Fiber(static function () {
        $g = stream();
        $a = $g->current();
        echo $a[0] === ComposedFirst && $a[0] === $a[2] ? 'same:' : 'wrong:';
        echo $a[3] === ComposedSecond && $a[3] === $a[5] ? 'same:' : 'wrong:';
        echo $a[0](), ':', $a[4](), '|';
        $g->next();
        echo $g->getReturn(), '|';
        return $a[3];
    });
    $fiber->start();
    $returned = $fiber->getReturn();
    echo $returned === ComposedSecond ? 'returned:' : 'wrong:';
    echo $returned();
}
